components.label: Toelichting
components.html:
GitHub fixture: reviews

Works on a pull request that already exists — run the pull request fixture first and feed its number in here, or point it at a real one. Reads the inline review conversations, and optionally answers and resolves the first open one. Both write steps are off by default: they write into somebody else's review.

  1. Pull request ophalen
  2. Reviewthreads ophalen
  3. Antwoorden in de thread
  4. Thread oplossen
  5. Reviewers vragen
  6. Review plaatsen

components.label: Repository
components.description: Must be a repository the token of the plugin configuration may reach. Fill it in even when the configuration has a default — the fixtures build search queries and REST paths out of it.

components.label: Pull-requestnummer
components.description: A pull request that already has inline review comments on it.

components.label: Eerste openstaande thread beantwoorden en oplossen
components.description: Writes a reply into somebody else's review conversation and marks it resolved. Needs at least one unresolved thread.

components.label: Reviewers vragen
components.description: Sends a review request, which notifies the people named below.

components.label: Reviewers
components.description: Comma separated GitHub logins. Nobody can be asked to review their own pull request.
